about: Stoked Surf School is a surf school and hire centre on Beach Road in Perranporth, on Cornwall's north coast. It hires boards and wetsuits daily on the beach and teaches everyone from complete beginners to progressing surfers. It tracks progress with its own seven-stage system, 'The Loop'. Lessons run seven days a week through the season.
